summary: Kravel Koalbeard trusts you to get a job done and to keep quiet about it. He has a new scheme, risky but with the promise of a bundle for you both. You carry his letter to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. This follows Rumors for Kravel.

sections.title: A Letter for Booty Bay
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard, the dwarf at the Mirage Raceway, calls you someone he can trust, both to finish a job and to hold your tongue about it. His new scheme carries risk, yet if it pays off the two of you stand to make a bundle. He apologizes for sending you back to Booty Bay, where his last job took you, and asks you to find Crank Fizzlebub there and hand over a letter. If Crank needs help, Kravel wants you to do your best, and says it will be worth the effort.

sections.title: Crank Reads the Scheme
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub reads the letter and sees that Kravel has a big scheme planned. Crank likes Kravel's sinister mind. The scheme will need something powerful to addle wits, and Crank wonders whether the mixture Zanzil gives his zombies could be put to use.

faq.q: Where does this journey begin and end?
aliases: who gives back to booty bay
faq.answer: It begins with Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. You carry his letter to Crank Fizzlebub, who is found at the Salty Sailor Tavern, in Booty Bay, in Stranglethorn Vale.
It follows Rumors for Kravel, the earlier step that took you to Booty Bay.
It is the letter you carry to Crank Fizzlebub. Kravel calls his scheme risky, and says that if it pays off the two of you could make a bundle.

faq.q: What should you do if Crank Fizzlebub needs help?
faq.answer: Kravel asks you to do your best to help him, saying it will be worth the effort.

aliases: what follows back to booty bay
faq.answer: The chain continues with Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout.
